_source: Catalogue row of the construction register (docs/design/v5.3-c-register.md): Britain's own school type, because no published table gives its teachers by upper years (see data/units/stock/GBR.json): the state-funded secondary school (ages 11 to 18, sixth form included), with its own figure secondary_pupils_per_teacher; only the nations whose stock file names this type are offered it. capacity, per nation, in the stock's own unit = the nation's mean enrolment per school in its stock: Britain 1 028 (4 299 417 pupils over 4 182 schools). STAND-IN numbers, none sourced: every figure marked below is the game's declared placeholder until the author's table of stand-ins (spec section 12). cost_eur_m: stand-in of 0.0575 M EUR per pupil, the same basis as the French and German school (the middle of a press-release anchor of 52 to 69 M EUR for a lycee of 900 to 1 200 places, not verified), applied to the 1 028-pupil unit (59.1 M EUR); a bounded search for the UK Department for Education's school delivery cost benchmarking found no per-pupil figure to read. running_eur_m: stand-in of 9 000 EUR per pupil a year (9.3 M EUR). staff: stand-in, one number for every nation (shown, moves nothing). build_months, overrun_odds, overrun_share, demolish_months, demolish_cost_share, band_units: the spec's stand-ins (sections 5, 7, 12). figure_elasticity: -1 (more places, fewer pupils per teacher). bloc_offset_per_pop_share: stand-in.
name: Secondary school
summary: A state secondary school for pupils aged 11 to 18, sixth form included.
